toolchain_cause_evidence.cause: The grammar has function parameter lists but no ellipsis production. The internal TFunction stores only a finite type_list, and cpt_func_arg requires both actual and formal lists to end simultaneously. Callsite where/named specs are checked after C argument type checking and cannot change arity.
